text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our strategy is to clinch the title of Umamusume of the Year by overpowering the competition with Taiki Shuttle's sheer power and speed. However…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I want a redo, a reprise, and a rematch! I'm beating Suzuka next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh… That's the spirit, El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, even should you best Suzuka, I won't be giving up the top seat to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Remember, the peak of the Japan Cup is none other than the throne of the Empress!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No, it's the perch for the Phantom Bird! I won't lose to you—ever!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: This year's Twinkle Series is shaping up to be very exciting.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Indeed. This time around, we have Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa, and Taiki Shuttle—the current sprinter champion.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Not to mention Silence Suzuka, who's really been knocking it out of the park recently.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Since returning from Hong Kong, her winning streak has shown no sign of ending! Even with top runners as her opponents!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: If she claims first place in the Japan Cup, the title of Umamusume of the Year is practically hers for the taking.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: What if the winner turns out to be El Condor Pasa or Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Well… I presume the title will go to whoever wins, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle has won all her G1 races so far. If she places first in the Mile Championship, she'll secure a fantastic record in the G1 sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I doubt Silence Suzuka's momentum will let up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There must be something else Taiki can do to attain the honor of being Umamusume of the Year…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Hey there! I just took a lap 'round the track!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Gosh, Trainer. Why the long face? Are ya feelin' blue?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I choose to believe in Taiki Shuttle's potential. I won't doubt her ever again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm prepared to consider every option for the chance of grasping onto even a single glimmer of hope.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, if ya say you're all right, then okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Sorry, Trainer, but can we finish up here for today?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeppers! Somebody wants to see me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And that somebody is Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! Sorry I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hi, Taiki. It's okay. Thank you for coming.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're more than welcome! ♪ Now then…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What'd ya wanna talk about?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Well, you see…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Do you remember last year's Mile Championship?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Of course! We ran in it together! Boy, that was one exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. I can't seem to forget it either.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I don't think I ever will. It's burned into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki… Your speed is still so vivid in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I couldn't stop chasing the speed you showed me that day… and the shadow you left behind.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I decided to stop holding back when I run. I've stayed at top speed since then, race after race—so that one day I could catch up to your shadow.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And yet, running at full speed hasn't been enough. Your shadow is still there in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So… Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I want to challenge you at the next Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship?! But aren't ya supposed to run in the Japan Cup?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Not anymore. I can't keep chasing after your shadow!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I… want to go beyond it. I want to see the scenery that lies beyond your top speed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That's all I wanted to say.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Let's meet again on the track, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle relays the conversation back to me. Finding out that Silence Suzuka has declared war is shocking, to say the least…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Trainer, I've been chewin' it over…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And I reckon this is a huge chance for me! Whaddya think?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka is currently the top-ranked Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Butting heads with her in a G1 race is nothing short of an enormous challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, should Taiki Shuttle come out of the battle victorious…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This could be an opportunity to overthrow Silence Suzuka's hold on everyone's hearts using Taiki's power and speed!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I've never seen Suzuka burnin' so brightly. She was intense.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I could tell all that talk about catchin' up and overtaking me was coming straight from the heart.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I don't plan on losin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: There can only be one King of the Mile! And only one Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna claim both titles with these legs of mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle's chances of becoming Umamusume of the Year hinge on the results of the Mile Championship!
